submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image1 to RUN S5/16, a UNIQUE full-body chibi sprite with genuine transparent alpha, native1254 square. Image1 is same-direction running rig and scale; image2 identity; image3 approved clean hand-painted finish.
Strict FRONT view running toward viewer, both blue eyes. RIGHT is screenLEFT with fan, LEFT is screenRIGHT empty and hip jade.
Exact unique phase: Early flight after left push: BOTH boots airborne, lowest boot y1150. RIGHT thigh leads forward, knee still bent; LEFT leg trails with knee folded. RIGHT fan arm held back beside hip, LEFT empty fist forward. Body rises20px. Show actual gap under both boots.
Preserve same orthographic camera, head size, torso and leg proportions. Fixed root x627 and invisible floor y1191. Only intentional knee/hip bob, ankle rotation and leg/arm stride changes; no zoom or recenter. Anatomical legs remain on their own screen sides; use running direction depth foreshortening naturally, not spread sideways. Separate both leg/boot silhouettes and clear knee-ankle path. Hold ONE ivory blue-water-dragon fan securely by black pivot in RIGHT hand; arm must move from shoulder/elbow in opposed stride. LEFT hand empty with loose running fist. Keep all clothing identity: navy straight bun, turquoisegold ornament and blue ribbons, blueivorygold wave-cloud scholar robe, white pants, bluegold boots and LEFT hip jade. Cloth/tassels lag the stride without covering both feet.
No extra arms/hands/feet/fans, no effects, water, glow, particles, floor, shadows, text, watermark. Full fan/hair/boots inside canvas margins. One independent drawing; not a mirror/warp/duplicate.
